newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: TAP reaches wage deal with ground staff.
newsitem.headline: TAP reaches wage deal with ground staff.

text.p: The board of loss-making state airline TAP-Air Portugal said on Wednesday it had reached an agreement with ground staff for a 3.5 percent wage increase.

The agreement signed on Tuesday with 10 unions, which took effect on January 1 1997 and followed three months of talks, covered more than 5,500 staff, representing three quarters of TAP's total workforce of 7,500, a statement said.
"This is a major event for TAP as all the unions representing ground staff signed an agreement with the company, which had not happened since May 1993," it said.
The agreement "shows the commitment of all the workers to turn the company into a viable operation," it added.
Last month TAP pilots staged a 48-hour strike over working hours, which grounded international flights.
